def r13_map27_variant(row,actor,state,daylight,width,has_offer):
        if row.get("status")!="approved" or has_offer:return None
        if actor["person"]!=row.get("person") or state.get("location")!=row.get("location"):return None
        if min(state.get("period",0),2) not in row.get("periods",[]):return None
        if not row.get("min_day",1)<=state.get("day",1)<=row.get("max_day",14):return None
        if "days" in row and state.get("day",1) not in row["days"]:return None
        flags=set(state.get("flags",[]))
        if not set(row.get("need_flags",[]))<=flags or flags.intersection(row.get("not_flags",[])):return None
        # Explicit allowlist: authored events and prior map9 actions are not generic idle.
        if actor["pose"] not in row.get("replace_poses",[]):return None
        variant=row.get("variants",{}).get(daylight)
        if not variant or variant.get("world_width")!=width:return None
        return variant

def r13_w2_where(person):
        s=store.room13;p=min(s["period"],2)
        if person=="mom":return "greenhouse" if r13_has("mom_reunited") else None
        if person=="granny":return None if s["granny_state"]=="detained" else "inn"
        if person=="resident_owlgp":return "school" if s["victim_state"]!="dead" else None
        if person=="nabi":
            if s["granny_state"]=="detained" and p==0:return "inn"
            return "school" if r13_has("shelter_ready") else r13_nabi_daily_where(s)
        if person=="buri":return "workshop"
        if person=="resident_tok":return "workshop" if p<2 else "school"
        if person=="resident_seori":return ("clinic","store","school")[p]
        if person=="resident_lamplighter":return ("square","workshop","gate")[p]
        if person=="resident_eunho":return "store"
        if person=="resident_teacher":return "school"
        if person=="resident_bori":return ("school","store","gate")[p]
        if person=="resident_nubi":return "school" if r13_has("nubi_protected") else ("facility","inn","school")[p]
        if person=="neoul":return "facility"
        if person=="karo":return "gate"
        if person=="seryeon":return "post" if p<2 else None
        if person=="doto":return "hall"
        if person=="bami":return "inn" if r13_has("bami_protected") else "hall" if p>0 else None
        return r13_resident_where(person)

        where=_r13_new_places_resident_where(person)
        place=r13_new_place_for(person)
        # Only the plain weekly slot moves; a special case above (clinic, shelter) wins.
